title: EgoSensorium / EgoSuperMimic: Human Demonstrations to Dexterous Manipulation
description: Two connected subprojects: synchronized multimodal human demonstration collection (EgoSensorium), and egocentric demonstration-conditioned bimanual tool manipulation with learned dynamics and reinforcement learning (EgoSuperMimic).
summary: 同一研究母项目下的两个子项目：EgoSensorium 构建同步多模态穿戴式数采系统、数据集和主动采集反馈；EgoSuperMimic 将 ego 视频中的手物交互转成机器人可执行的双手工具操作，研究 SuperMimic 式世界模型训练、接触切换与长程衔接。两者通过带时间、坐标、接触和置信度的 demonstration manifest 连接，分别验收数据质量与机器人执行效果。
asset_alt: EgoSensorium wearable acquisition architecture with head stereo, two wrist cameras, gaze and face capture, hand pressure, muscle sensing, spatial audio, six Vive trackers and chest haptic feedback.
asset_caption: EgoSensorium 子项目：同步穿戴式采集与胸部 haptic 反馈。其标定、手物轨迹和接触参考通过统一 manifest 接入 EgoSuperMimic 子项目。

subprojects.title: EgoSuperMimic · Egocentric Video to Dexterous Tool Manipulation
subprojects.body: ego 重建 → 统一交互参考 → 接触保持重定向 → ReferenceManager → 参考条件双手工具策略。参考同时进入目标输入与跟踪/任务奖励；机器人仿真转移训练可微世界模型，短时想象 rollout 与 critic 更新策略。研究接触切换、重建不确定性和连续多阶段执行。

subprojects.asset_alt: EgoSuperMimic proposed method illustrated with first-person bimanual screwdriver use, hand contact reconstruction, robot retargeting, dexterous robot tool use, and a world-model policy-training loop.
subprojects.asset_caption: EgoSuperMimic：ego 交互参考与机器人仿真转移分别进入策略条件和动力学学习，面向双手工具操作的连续执行。拟议方法，尚待实验验证。

details: EgoSensorium — Wearable stack: head stereo plus two wrist cameras, CYMPLE gaze/face capture, circular microphone array, six Vive trackers, Yudie gloves, flexible pressure films, bilateral muscle patches and a dominant-arm Pegasus armband.
EgoSensorium — Spatial contract: head, chest, upper arms and hands form a shared world-frame kinematic tree; wrist cameras, pressure maps and spatial audio are transformed into the same geometry.
EgoSensorium — Temporal contract: every stream retains device timestamps, master-clock mapping, offset/drift estimates, latency, confidence and missing-modality masks.
EgoSensorium — Bidirectional protocol: chest haptic encodes observation quality, model uncertainty or robotability through a small pulse vocabulary; each command and wearer response is logged.
EgoSensorium — Dataset layers: original sensor packets, synchronized calibrated streams, semantic and physical annotations, and robot-ready relative wrist/contact representations.
EgoSensorium — Benchmarks: intent and action anticipation, contact and pressure forecasting, spatial audio grounding, multimodal Human-to-Robot Transfer and Haptic-Guided Active Collection.

Shared interface: timestamps and clock mapping; camera/world coordinates and metric scale; left/right hand states; object/tool poses and articulated states; contact phases, confidence and missing-modality masks. EgoSuperMimic can also consume external ego demonstrations independently of the full wearable rig.

EgoSuperMimic — Human video supplies reference motion and interaction evidence. Robot dynamics supervision requires robot state-action-next-state transitions; human trajectories without robot actions are not interchangeable with simulator or robot replay.

EgoSuperMimic — Long-horizon acceptance means continuous execution across contact phases without oracle resets. Floating-hand tracking, arm-hand feasibility, trajectory replay and closed-loop hardware policy deployment are distinct validation levels.
EgoSuperMimic — Reference contract: 每段演示保留时间戳、米制尺度、camera-to-world、左右腕与手关键点、工具及被操作物的位姿/速度/关节状态、接触关系、置信度与缺失掩码。接触标签是证据估计，不从指尖距离直接推断接触力。
EgoSuperMimic — Retargeting: 优先保留工具/物体坐标中的指尖、掌腕和工具工作端关系；同时约束机器人限位、双臂可达性、自碰撞与时间平滑。运动学回放与动力学可执行性分别评价。
EgoSuperMimic — Policy interface: ReferenceManager(demo_id, phase, lookahead) 提供当前及未来目标窗口。策略以当前观测和相对目标误差为条件；候选动作是 q_cmd = q_ref + α·Δq，并与真实控制器的限幅、滤波、频率和延迟一致。
EgoSuperMimic — Dynamics contract: 物理状态包含机器人关节与速度、工具/目标物位姿与速度及关节状态；控制器历史单独保持。动力学使用统一基座/世界坐标，策略可使用物体相对坐标。模型输入保留执行动作来源；残差动作须配套参考目标。
EgoSuperMimic — Reward contract: 交互几何跟踪、阶段接触与工具实际效果共同定义目标，辅以碰撞、限位和动作约束。想象奖励从预测状态可微计算；硬成功标准在物理仿真与真机上评估，不能只凭工具空转或 imagined return 判定完成。
EgoSuperMimic — Supervision boundary: 重建置信度调节参考跟踪目标；物理仿真中的失败转移仍可监督动力学。想象展开只能递推预测物理状态，不能用未来演示位姿或真实仿真状态逐步替换预测。未来参考是目标，不是未来实际观测。

references.title: Dex-Supermimic
references.notes: EgoSuperMimic training implementation: Wuji Hand 2 in-hand cube reorientation using mjlab / MuJoCo Warp. Extending to ego references, moving wrists, bimanual tools and phase transitions requires additional implementation.

references.title: SuperMimic
references.notes: EgoSuperMimic method reference: fit dynamics from simulator transitions and optimize policies through differentiable imagined rollouts; original results concern humanoid whole-body tracking.

references.title: REGRIND
references.notes: EgoSuperMimic tool-use baseline: interaction-preserving retargeting and object-centric residual RL, with LEAP / WUJI scissors and screwdriver hardware demonstrations. Implementation: https://github.com/yunhaif/regrind

references.title: DexMimic
references.notes: EgoSuperMimic generalist tracking comparison: bimanual hand-object trajectories and value-guided reset state / phase allocation.

references.title: MorphMimic
references.notes: Morphology-conditioned world model and policy sharing across humanoids; a design reference rather than evidence of dexterous tool manipulation.

references.title: ROHIT / COP: Objects along Hand Interaction Timelines
references.notes: EgoSuperMimic reconstruction reference: object pose constraints and propagation along static and stable-grasp segments; regrasping, sliding and handover require separate treatment.

references.title: Do As I Do
references.notes: EgoSuperMimic video-to-robot baseline: hand-object reconstruction and sampling-based physical retargeting from everyday RGB videos.

references.title: EgoMatrix
references.notes: Direct related work: ego video to bimanual robot trajectories through relative/contact-focused reconstruction, retargeting and RL. Novelty must go beyond this pipeline combination.

references.notes: 接口依据：state.py / sim.py 定义单手单物体状态与执行动作；mdp.py / observations.py 定义方块任务；networks.py 包含 20 维动作；runner.py / buffer.py 提供交替训练与 replay 骨架。源码接口可复用不等于已完成双手集成或复现。

risks_decisions: Keep tracker and camera extrinsics rigid through shared hand pods and repeat calibration checks after every refit.
Record raw device clocks, synchronization events, drift estimates and missing-modality masks for every episode.
Log haptic commands and actuator state so vibration artifacts in audio, IMU and muscle streams remain identifiable.
Evaluate wearer burden, naturalness and cognitive load alongside data throughput and model performance.
Use consent, pseudonymous identities and access tiers for face, gaze, voice and physiological signals.
Require every released modality to connect to a benchmark, ablation and documented sensor-quality gate.

EgoSensorium and EgoSuperMimic are distinct subprojects under this parent: sensor/data quality and active collection belong to EgoSensorium; reconstruction-to-control, learned dynamics and manipulation performance belong to EgoSuperMimic.

Compare model-free and learned-dynamics training with matched robot assets, reference trajectories, observations, actions, rewards and compute accounting. REGRIND and Dex-Supermimic use different simulator stacks; a simulator change is a separate confound.

Treat contact-phase and uncertainty-aware tracking as research hypotheses. Judge policies in physical simulation and on matched hardware, not only by imagined return; distinguish training-reference coverage from held-out generalization.
Real human demonstration references do not by themselves identify robot dynamics. Preserve action provenance and embodiment when introducing any real transition data.

timeline.target_cycle: Synchronized human demonstrations → calibrated hand-object references → reference-conditioned bimanual control → matched robot validation
timeline.target_note: EgoSensorium evaluates sensor and dataset utility; EgoSuperMimic evaluates manipulation success, robustness and learning efficiency. Task-specific schedules and acceptance evidence stay on task cards.
